summary_en: The study tests KB707, a genetically modified herpes simplex type 1 virus given by inhalation, in adults with advanced solid tumors affecting the lungs, including non-small cell lung cancer. KB707 is given by nebulization, weekly for three weeks and then every three weeks when used alone, or every 2 weeks with Keytruda (given every 6 weeks) or every 3 weeks with docetaxel in the combination groups, and treatment continues until progression, death, unacceptable toxicity, or another listed reason. The study is designed to measure safety, tolerability, preliminary efficacy, and immunologic effect, and it is a Phase 1/2 study.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa KB707, un virus del herpes simple tipo 1 modificado genéticamente que se administra por inhalación, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que afectan los pulmones, incluido el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. KB707 se administra por nebulización, una vez por semana durante tres semanas y luego cada tres semanas cuando se usa solo, o cada 2 semanas con Keytruda (administrado cada 6 semanas) o cada 3 semanas con docetaxel en los grupos de combinación, y el tratamiento continúa hasta la progresión, la muerte, toxicidad inaceptable u otra razón indicada. El estudio está diseñado para medir la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la eficacia preliminar y el efecto inmunológico, y es un estudio de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older at consent
At least one measurable lung lesion per RECIST v1.1
NSCLC combination cohorts: stage 3 or 4 NSCLC with limited prior lines of therapy
not_for: Pregnant, nursing, or planning pregnancy during treatment or through three months after last dose
Not fully recovered from prior surgery or radiotherapy
NSCLC combination cohorts: active brain or leptomeningeal metastases, or another active cancer
NSCLC combination cohorts: active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment, known hepatitis, or prior checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis needing steroids
